# QA Plan: pixelarrow v5

**Date**: 2026-10-10
**Generated by**: /qa-plan (story QA-01, wave W6), as qa-lead
**Scope**: 86 stories across 25 epics (`docs/v5/plan/STORIES.md`), 24 screens (`design/ux/screen-flow.md` S01–S24), 10 GDDs (`design/gdd/`)
**Engine**: Phaser 3.90 + TypeScript + Vite (Telegram Mini App), Cloudflare Workers server in `server/` (V5-028: stay on 3.90)
**Sprint file**: `docs/v5/plan/SPRINTS.md` (waves W1–W25). v5 tracking lives in `docs/v5/PROGRESS.md` (V5-009), not `production/sprints/`.
**Config**: `modes.rigor: standard` and `automation: autonomous` (V5-010), so `qa.level` resolves to **standard** and `workflow` to **standard**. `testing.strict` is unset, so the `coding-standards.md` defaults apply: Logic, Integration, Visual/Feel and UI evidence is BLOCKING; Config/Data is ADVISORY.

Consumers of this plan: QA-02 (regression scripts), QA-03 (full-game playthrough and playtest scoring), QA-04 (code review), QA-05 (perf), QA-06 (gate, REPORT.md), and every story's `/story-done`.

## 1. Evidence rule per story type

Every story's `/story-done` checks this table. The gate codes (G-ALL, G-UI, ...) in STORIES.md stay in force on top of it.

| Type | Required evidence | Where | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Logic** | Vitest unit tests that pass: every formula at normal, zero, max and GDD edge values; each state transition; a replay-determinism hash test when the sim changes (G-TRAIN). Balance rows before and after when G-MECH applies. | `tests/<topic>.test.ts`, `server/test/<topic>.test.ts`, `docs/v5/balance/<id>.md` | BLOCKING |
| **Integration** | A test that crosses the boundary (client and server, save and load, scene and scene, sim and replay) **or** a scripted Playwright run that checks it. Both sides tested when G-ONLINE applies. | `tests/`, `server/test/`, `scripts/*.mjs` | BLOCKING |
| **Visual/Feel** | Retained screenshots or a short clip, plus `EVIDENCE.md` with the criteria and a signed-off row (art-director or technical-artist agent, then the Director). AS-* stories: the prompt and the check in `ASSET_LOG.md` and `scripts/art/check.mjs` passing. | `docs/v5/shots/<id>/`, `docs/v5/ASSET_LOG.md` | BLOCKING |
| **UI** | A retained screenshot of every screen and state touched at **390x844 and 360x780**, en and ru; 320x640 and 320x568 through layout-check with 0 new violations; the ELEMENT_MAP rows present or their removal cited. No sign-off needed. | `docs/v5/shots/<id>/` | BLOCKING |
| **Config/Data** | Smoke pass (G-ALL). A data validation test when the data has rules (e.g. EV-02 dominated choices). | merge gates | ADVISORY |

Rules that apply to every type:

- A criterion that says "feels", "reads" or "fair" needs a benchmark or a playtest protocol (Section 9). It never passes on the author's opinion.
- A screenshot is evidence only if the agent looked at it and the report says what it shows.
- A test with no assertion is MISSING, not ADEQUATE.

## 3. Risk-based strategy per epic

Likelihood (L) and impact (I) are 1–3. Risk = L x I. Test effort follows risk: 6–9 gets dedicated release tests, 3–4 gets story tests plus smoke, 1–2 gets story tests only.

| Epic | Main risk | L | I | Risk | Strategy |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EP-04 sim train, saves | Live players lose a campaign in the mixed-bundle window, or online battles in flight are voided at deploy. | 2 | 3 | **6** | Release test suites in Sections 7 and 8; fixture saves from real v4/v5 shapes; server and client tests both sides. |
| EP-05/06/07/10 sim features | Non-determinism between browser, Node and workerd (float trig, iteration order) breaks server replay. | 2 | 3 | **6** | A replay hash test per feature (G-TRAIN); ST-04 all-features log replayed in workerd; no `Math.sin/cos` in the sim (V5-037 Taylor rule) checked by grep in QA-04. |
| EP-11 controls | Wrong orders on touch (C1); knob vs soldier priority; undo restores the wrong state. | 2 | 3 | **6** | Pure hit-test unit tests; smoke touch checks kept and extended (Section 5); playtest counts of wrong-group orders. |
| EP-13–21 screens | 20 scene rebuilds drop an element or break Back; ru text overflow at 320. | 3 | 2 | **6** | ELEMENT_MAP row check per screen; nav test; layout-check 4 sizes x 2 languages; per-screen manual checks (Section 6). |
| EP-08 campaign arc | Old saves break on new fields; the 8-man start changes smoke and balance assumptions; the host softlocks the end state. | 2 | 2 | 4 | Save fixtures; host test with a debug save; smoke update owned by AR-01. |
| EP-09 events | A pending event is lost or doubled on kill and reload; RNG draws shift the world seed. | 2 | 2 | 4 | Kill-and-reload test; same-save-same-events test. |
| EP-03 live fixes | Regression of B1/B2 (scene data). | 1 | 3 | 3 | `tests/sceneStart.test.ts` in the regression suite; smoke runs a campaign attack after the tutorial. |
| EP-01/02 foundation | Token or kit change shifts every screen; a 44 pt rule floods violations. | 2 | 2 | 4 | Tokens test, layout-check with the allowlist naming owners; Kit scene as the visual baseline. |
| EP-23 feel and audio | Juice breaks the sim tick or ignores Reduce motion; perf hit. | 2 | 2 | 4 | Tick-count test; A11Y-12/13 checks; perf budget. |
| EP-24 economy | Re-costs desync duel budget between client and server. | 2 | 2 | 4 | Server budget test; duel-smoke. |
| EP-22 assets | Invented features in Gemini art; wrong sizes. | 2 | 1 | 2 | Tile-by-tile allowlist check; `check.mjs`. |
| EP-25 final QA | Flaky smokes hide real failures (the smoke.mjs flake). | 2 | 2 | 4 | Name failing checks (Section 6); rerun policy. |

### Top 5 risks

1. **Mixed-bundle save loss** (V5-036/038). A cached v4 bundle meets a v6 save; a device on an old campaign overwrites or follows the wrong campaign. Tests: Section 8, cases SV-01..SV-12.
2. **Online cutover voids battles or strands v4 clients** (V5-033/040). `MIN_SIM_VERSION` is already 2 on `v5`, so every production client (no `simVersion`) gets 426 at deploy and has no reload UI. Tests: Section 7, cases OC-01..OC-12.
3. **Replay non-determinism across engines** after six rule features land in one train. Tests: per-feature hash tests, ST-04 all-features log replayed in workerd, a Node vs Chromium hash comparison in QA-02.
4. **Screen rebuilds drop elements or break Back** across 24 screens, 4 sizes and 2 languages. Tests: Section 6 matrix, ELEMENT_MAP check, nav test.
5. **Touch control regressions** (selection priority, undo, Then queue) that unit tests can't see. Tests: smoke touch checks plus the new battle regression script, and playtest counts in QA-03.

## 4. Automated tests required (open stories)

Merged stories already have tests (Section 5 inventory). For open Logic and Integration stories the file and the cases are in Section 2. These edge cases are added to every sim story on top of its ACs, from the GDD Edge Cases sections:

- A group of 1 man (orb, feint, cohesion, standard bearer alone).
- An army with an empty Reserve (B3 numbering).
- An order on a routed or dead group: ignored and logged, no hash change.
- A battle that hits the time limit (army break vs timeout precedence).
- A replay log with an unknown order kind: refused by zod, never a crash.
- Max save size with every v6 field filled (the 3,800-char CloudStorage part budget).

## 6. Smoke scope and the smoke.mjs flake

### 6.1 Smoke scope before any QA hand-off

1. Boot to the Campaign hub with no console error (smoke, fullscreen-smoke).
2. First run: tutorial offered, played, skip asks, reward (tutorial-smoke).
3. New campaign, march, encounter, deploy, battle, Results, back to the map (smoke).
4. Settlement recruit, Army, Hero stat point and perks, equip from the stash (smoke).
5. An ability used in battle (smoke).
6. Duel hub, Team, Armoury, ladder floor through the real battle scene (duel-smoke).
7. API down: the game stays playable; Stars flow and merchant against mocks (online-smoke).
8. Live backend: war attack, clan, live duel (online-e2e) when online code changed.
9. Save and reload: the campaign resumes where it was (save tests plus a smoke reload step, to add).
10. Layout-check with 0 new violations at the sizes in Section 7.
11. Perf within the Section 10 budget (QA-05 and any story that touches boot, sheets or the battle loop).

### 6.2 The flake

PROGRESS item 14 and the AI-01/ST-02c/LF-02 merge record: `smoke.mjs` failed once under load with **1 check** and the report could not say which one.

Cause in the harness: `check()` in `scripts/lib/harness.mjs` prints `PASS name` or `FAIL name` per line, but `finish()` prints only `1 FAILED`. An integrator who reads the tail of a long, interleaved log under load sees the count and not the name. A thrown error (for example `target` being `null` before `tap(target[0], ...)` when no clear tile is found) ends the run with a stack trace and no check name at all.

**Smallest fix (proposed, not done here: code is out of scope):** keep the failed names in the harness and print them in the verdict line.

```js
// scripts/lib/harness.mjs
const failed = [];
export function check(name, ok, detail = '') {
  console.log(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name} ${detail}`);
  if (!ok) { failures++; failed.push(name); }
}
// in finish(): console.log(failures ? `${fail(failures)}: ${failed.join(' | ')}` : pass);
```

That is about 3 changed lines. It names the failing check for all seven smokes, since they share `finish()`. Optional, a further 2 lines: track the last check name and print `ABORTED after "<name>"` from a `process.on('uncaughtException')` handler, so a crash also says where it happened.

Owner: `scripts/lib/harness.mjs` is in no story's file set. **Recommendation to the Director:** dispatch it as a one-file fixer now, or add `scripts/lib/harness.mjs` to QA-02's files. Rerun policy until then: a single smoke failure under load is rerun once alone; the second result counts, and both logs are kept.

## 8. Save migration and cloud sync release tests

Context: two-slot atomic saves (S4-FIX-SAVES), `SAVE_VERSION` 6 (ST-02, ADR-0002), the cloud downgrade guard `409 save_version_downgrade` (V5-036, ST-02b), `campaignId` and cloud-wins-on-mismatch with `px_replaced` (V5-038, ST-02c), and the rollback caveat (V5-026: v4 reads slot 0 only).

"v4 bundle" = the `main` build in production today. "v6 client" = the v5 release build.

| ID | Precondition | Steps | Expected result | Pass criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SV-01 | Real v5 player save (fixture) on the device | Boot the v6 client | Migrates to v6 with every old field kept and defaults for new ones | Field-by-field fixture diff is empty except added defaults (exists: `saveMigration.test.ts`) |
| SV-02 | Every historical save version 1..5 | Boot v6 | Each loads | `saveRecovery.test.ts` passes |
| SV-03 | v6 save local; device then gets a cached v4 bundle | Boot v4 | v4 refuses the v6 save without overwriting it | localStorage v6 save bytes unchanged after the v4 boot |
| SV-04 | As SV-03, v4 then starts a new campaign and saves (v5) | v4 uploads to the cloud | Server refuses: 409 `save_version_downgrade`; the stored v6 copy stays | Cloud copy byte-equal before and after |
| SV-05 | After SV-04 the device boots v6 again | v6 boot sync | Cloud v6 has another `campaignId` at ≥ version: cloud wins, local goes to `px_replaced`, a notice shows | `px_replaced` holds the v4-made campaign; the real campaign is loaded; notice visible |
| SV-06 | Same campaign, cloud newer | v6 boot | Adopted with no backup and no notice | `stateReplace.test.ts` case passes |
| SV-07 | No cloud copy | v6 boot | Local loads untouched | as above |
| SV-08 | Device A on campaign X; device B starts "New campaign" Y and syncs | Device A boots | A follows Y; X kept in `px_replaced` (documented V5-038 consequence) | `px_replaced` on A holds X intact |
| SV-09 | A legacy save with no `campaignId` | First v6 save | Gets an id; no false mismatch on the next boot | id written once and stable over 2 boots |
| SV-10 | Max-size v6 save | Cloud write | Every CloudStorage part ≤ 3,800 chars; read back equal | `saveMigration.test.ts` size case passes; read-back deep-equal |
| SV-11 | Kill the tab during a save write (two slots) | Reboot | The last good save loads; the corrupt slot goes to `px_corrupt` | No silent wipe |
| SV-12 | v6 save; roll back to v4 (V5-026) | Boot v4 | v4 shows the last **pre-v5** save from slot 0 | Documented in REPORT as a known rollback caveat; not a failure |
| SV-13 | Battle begun in v6, app killed | Reboot | The battle stands (permadeath kept) | Pending battle resolved as begun |
| SV-14 | Offline (CloudStorage unavailable) | Play, save, reconnect | Local save kept; sync resumes; no duplicate campaign | One campaign in cloud after reconnect |

**The mixed-bundle release window**: Telegram caches the web bundle, so v4 and v6 builds coexist on one account for hours to days. SV-03..SV-08 run as one Playwright script against a local server with the two builds served on two ports (QA-02, `scripts/regression/mixed-bundle.mjs`), sharing a fake CloudStorage. The release is blocked if SV-03, SV-04 or SV-05 fails.

## 9. Online sim-version cutover tests

Context: `SIM_VERSION` 2; `MIN_SIM_VERSION` and `SOCKET_MIN_SIM_VERSION` raised to 2 with FO-01 (V5-033 rule); 426 `sim_version_unsupported`, 409 `sim_version_mismatch`, socket close 4426 (V5-027); in-flight tickets replay with their stored version (V5-040); migration 0016 adds the `sim_version` columns and takes effect only on deploy.

Finding to carry to ST-04 and the release plan: ADR-0001's ordering note says the versioning plumbing should be deployed and old clients aged out **before** the first v2 deploy. v5 ships both in one release, so at deploy every production client (no `simVersion`) is below the floor at once. It needs a graceful 426 path. The plumbing release cannot be separated now without the Director's call.

| ID | Precondition | Steps | Expected result | Pass criteria |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OC-01 | v5 server; v4 bundle (no `simVersion`) | Start a ladder floor, a war attack, a battle verify | 426 on each; the v4 UI shows an error and stays usable | No 500; no uncaught error in the v4 console; the hub is still navigable |
| OC-02 | v5 server; v4 bundle | Open a live duel socket | Error frame and close 4426 | v4 shows a message, no reconnect storm (≤ 3 retries in 60 s) |
| OC-03 | v1 ticket issued before deploy (fixture row with `sim_version` 1) | v4 client submits within TTL | Replayed with the frozen v1 sim; resolved | exists: `simVersion.test.ts` in-flight block |
| OC-04 | v1 ticket | v6 client submits it | 409 mismatch, ticket closed | exists |
| OC-05 | v1 ticket expired | v4 submits | 410, no replay | exists |
| OC-06 | Ladder TTL 30 min (after CT-06) | Submit a v1 ticket at 29 min | Replayed by v1 | **New**: the v1 replayer must stay for ≥ the longest TTL (30 min); test in `server/test/cutover.test.ts` |
| OC-07 | Stored async raid replay with `sim_version` 1 | v6 client opens the raid log | Labelled as old rules or declined; never replayed under v2 | No replay mismatch toast; label visible |
| OC-08 | v1 and v2 clients in the duel queue | Queue both | Never paired | exists |
| OC-09 | Challenge accepted, then one side reloads onto v2 | Start | Refused, not started | exists |
| OC-10 | DB without migration 0016 | v5 server boots | Fails closed with a clear error, or the deploy order in OPS.md prevents it | OPS.md lists "migrate D1 before deploying the worker"; a server test or manual check proves the order |
| OC-11 | All-features client log (ST-04) | Server replays | Same hash in workerd as in the browser | `trainReplay.test.ts` plus the cross-engine check (Section 5.3) |
| OC-12 | v6 client, v5 server | Full online-e2e | 34 checks pass | online-e2e green |

Run OC-01 and OC-02 by serving the `main` build (`git worktree` of `main`, read-only) against the local v5 server with DEV_AUTH. Nothing is deployed. `.dev.vars` is created from the example and deleted afterwards (PROGRESS item 7).

## 13. Full-game Playwright playthrough (Phase 8, QA-03), outline

A node script on its own port (V5-004), using `scripts/lib/harness.mjs` with real touch events. Shots are JPEG ≤ 150 KB at **390x844, 360x780, 320x640**, named `NN-<step>-<size>-<lang>.jpg` in `docs/v5/qa/shots/`. The en run is complete; the ru run repeats steps 1–4, 9, 14–18 for text. Each step lists what to check; each check is logged as PASS/FAIL with its name.

1. **Fresh boot** (localStorage cleared): Boot line, First run with key art and three mode cards. Shots.
2. **Tutorial**: play all steps with touch (select, pan, pinch, drag, Fight, tap-move, shapes, knob, focus, undo, Then, morale glyph, flank arc). Narrator never covers the Shape row or FIGHT. Time it (about 3.5 min). Reward.
3. **Campaign start**: 8 men, 40 food. Hub: Army, Stash, Camp above the fold at 320x640. Score "goal after 10 min" later.
4. **World map**: march, an unreachable tap, an event card (pause underneath, 2–3 choices), the journal.
5. **First band fight**: encounter sheet (doctrine, tell, captain), deploy with undo (10 steps), works locked, Fight; count decisions and time to contact; pause at random and write who is winning. Results: why-line, Losses, spoils.
6. **Settlement**: recruit with hire Undo, Services with the Drillmaster, Sell confirm.
7. **Army and Hero**: level-up with an A/B perk choice (write the reason), equip by tap item then tap slot, retrain cost.

## 14. Exit criteria for REPORT.md (QA-06)

v5 is ready for the user's release decision only if all of these hold. QA-06 writes each with its evidence link in `docs/v5/qa/GATE.md`. One unmet line makes the verdict **NOT READY**. A line that could not be checked makes it **NOT ASSESSED**, and the report says which.

1. **Gates**: `tsc`, client vitest, server vitest, `vite build`, layout-check (4 sizes x en, ru x plain, tg) with 0 new violations, and all 7 smokes green on two consecutive runs on an idle machine.
2. **Stories**: every story in scope is Complete with evidence per Section 1. `/test-evidence-review` over the branch: no MISSING or INCOMPLETE on a BLOCKING type. Cut stories are listed with the cut-order reason (V5-031).
3. **Bugs**: no open S1 or S2. Every S3 has an owner. B1–B6 closed with their regression tests (Section 5.2).
4. **Saves**: SV-01..SV-14 pass. SV-12 (rollback, V5-026) is stated in REPORT as a known caveat.
5. **Online**: OC-01..OC-12 pass. The OPS.md cutover plan names the deploy order (D1 migration, then server and client together), the v1 replayer retention (≥ 30 min ticket TTL), and what v4 clients see.
6. **Determinism**: ST-04's all-features log replays to the same hash in workerd, Node and Chromium.
7. **Balance**: `npm run balance -- 400` in TRAIN2.md and FINAL.md within noise of each other; every GDD target marked met or missed, with misses in DECISIONS.md.
8. **Screens**: all 24 screens verified at 390x844 and 360x780 in en and ru (Section 7.2), shots linked; every ELEMENT_MAP row present or its removal cited.
9. **Accessibility**: A11Y-01..21 pass or have a logged deviation (A11Y-11, A11Y-22). The tier stated as Standard, not full AA.
10. **Performance**: every BLOCKING row in Section 11 met. Bundle delta recorded. A real-phone measurement listed as open.
11. **Experiential ACs**: each scored or marked NOT ASSESSED (needs humans), with the list handed to the user.
12. **Hygiene**: no Claude co-author trailer in any v5 commit; nothing pushed or deployed; `main` untouched; `.dev.vars` removed.
13. **The smoke flake**: the harness names failing checks (Section 6.2), or the flake is recorded as open with its rerun logs.

## 16. Findings for the Director

1. **smoke.mjs flake**: the harness prints only the failure count in its verdict. A 3-line fix names the failing check in all 7 smokes (Section 6.2). `scripts/lib/harness.mjs` has no owner: dispatch a fixer, or add it to QA-02.
2. **AR-01 will break `smoke.mjs:30`** (3 heroes). AR-01 does not own `scripts/smoke.mjs`. Add it to AR-01's files, or the integrator fixes it in the same merge.
3. **Cutover ordering**: ADR-0001 expects the plumbing deployed and old clients aged out before the v2 deploy. v5 ships both at once, so every v4 client gets 426 at deploy. OC-01/OC-02 must prove v4 degrades gracefully. If it doesn't, the options are a two-step release (plumbing first) or a server-side 426 message v4 can show. That is a release-plan decision for the user, recorded in REPORT.
4. **v1 replayer retention vs CT-06**: the ladder ticket TTL goes to 30 min, so the frozen v1 sim must stay at least 30 min after deploy (V5-040 says "one ticket lifetime"). OPS.md should state the number.
5. **320x640** is not in the layout-check default SIZES until LF-03 (W7). Stories before W7 pass `--sizes` explicitly.
6. **A11Y-09** has no automated check. F-01 AC4 implies one; confirm it lands in layout-check.
